set -u BARGE=/usr/local/bin/barge RUN_ROOT=${TMPDIR:-/var/tmp} WORK=$(/usr/bin/mktemp -d "$RUN_ROOT/barge-maintain.XXXXXX") || { echo "barge maintain: no temporary directory under $RUN_ROOT; nothing was run" exit 2 } cleanup() { if [ -n "$WORK" ] && [ -d "$WORK" ]; then /bin/rm -f "$WORK/preview.json" "$WORK/real.json" "$WORK/plan.json" /bin/rmdir "$WORK" 2>/dev/null fi } trap cleanup EXIT
# 1. Preview. Effect-free; it writes only the plan file this script asked for. "$BARGE" maintain --json --plan-out "$WORK/plan.json" >"$WORK/preview.json" preview_exit=$? if [ "$preview_exit" -ne 0 ]; then echo "barge maintain: preview exit=$preview_exit; recorded, not retried" exit "$preview_exit" fi
# 2. Read the digest and the candidate count from the preview document. read_key() { /usr/bin/python3 - "$WORK/preview.json" "$1" <<'PY' import json, sys document = json.load(open(sys.argv[1])) print(document["data"][sys.argv[2]]) PY } DIGEST=$(read_key plan_digest) || { echo "barge maintain: the preview is not one readable document; recorded, not retried" exit 3 } CANDIDATES=$(read_key candidates) || { echo "barge maintain: the preview reports no candidate count; recorded, not retried" exit 3 } if [ "$CANDIDATES" -eq 0 ]; then # The preview ran and there is nothing to do. This is not a real run. exit 0 fi
# 3. Exactly one real run, with this preview's digest and its exact bytes. No # retry, and never a digest from an earlier preview. "$BARGE" maintain --json --plan "$WORK/plan.json" --plan-sha256 "$DIGEST" >"$WORK/real.json" real_exit=$? echo "barge maintain: real exit=$real_exit digest=$DIGEST candidates=$CANDIDATES; recorded, not retried" exit "$real_exit"
